heroHeadline: Germany Hits 128 GWp Solar Target Ahead of Schedule; UK's East Anglia THREE Offshore Wind Farm Completes All 95 Foundations
heroSubtitle: 3,910 days since the Paris Agreement — BSW-Solar confirmed (August 20) that Germany's installed photovoltaic capacity passed 128 GWp, hitting its statutory 2026 EEG expansion target ahead of schedule, with over 6 million solar installations now operating nationwide. Off the Suffolk coast, ScottishPower Renewables and Masdar completed installation of all 95 foundations for the £4 billion, 1.4 GW East Anglia THREE offshore wind farm (August 17-18), set to power 1.3 million UK homes once fully operational by year-end. Both milestones extend a summer of European renewable records, following July's news that solar became the EU's largest single power source for the first time.
footerNote: Data sourced from IEA, IRENA, Ember, BloombergNEF, Rho Motion, UNFCCC, and major international outlets. All figures reflect verified, publicly available data through August 2026.
